info.name: Novalnet API (2.1.0 v) Payment
info.description: ## Novalnet API (2.1.0 V) Postman Collection This is a postman collection covering Novalnet's Direct and Hosted Payment APIs. See Hosted Payment API - [https://developer.novalnet.com/onlinepayments/hostedpageparameterreference](https://developer.novalnet.com/onlinepayments/hostedpageparameterreference) Direct API - [https://developer.novalnet.com/onlinepayments/apiparameterreference](https://developer.novalnet.com/onlinepayments/apiparameterreference) for more details. ## Prerequisites [Postman](https://www.getpostman.com/downloads/) [Novalnet Account](https://admin.novalnet.de/) To start, fork the collection from [Novalnet's public workspace](https://www.postman.com/novalnetag/novalnet-public-workspace/collection) within Postman. Enter a name for your fork and select the workspace where it will be created: - Along with the collection, you can also fork the Environment. ### Set your API Signature & Tariff ID To run requests, you must supply your [API Signature and Tariff ID](https://admin.novalnet.de/) and set it as an [environment variable](https://learning.postman.com/docs/sending-requests/variables/) within your workspace. Use the forked environment template from Novalnet's public workspace to configure your credentials. Add your credentials listed below as a variable to the environment and save: - signature - payment access key - tariff - subscription tariff Set the Novalnet Test Environment to active If your environment is set up correctly, you should see your base URL if you mouse over the `base_URL` variable in the URL field: Ensure the configured payment access key is reflected by the mouse over in all the request file headers with base64 encoded format. ## Make a test transaction You should be ready now to make a test transaction. Choose any of the requests from **Payments** or **Authorize** folder to initiate a transaction. Verify the Test result of the execution You can change the parameters in the collection variables you need to change. To know about the parameter in details refer to the link - Hosted Payment API - [https://developer.novalnet.com/onlinepayments/hostedpageparameterreference](https://developer.novalnet.com/onlinepayments/hostedpageparameterreference) Direct API - [https://developer.novalnet.com/onlinepayments/apiparameterreference](https://developer.novalnet.com/onlinepayments/apiparameterreference) ## Tokenization Select the Payment folder under One click or Zero amount and choose as Run folder. Now click the Run Novalnet API button. Verify the Test result of the execution of one click or zero amount process with token

You can integrate the Hosted Payment Page easily via a classic redirection. Alternatively, you can integrate our payment form as an iFrame in your checkout. All payment forms offered by Novalnet are PCI-DSS-compliant (for Credit/Debit Cards), which means that you do not require time-consuming and costly PCI-DSS certification. Besides, you can use external references such as CSS and Javascript files.

The payment forms offered by Novalnet are responsive (i.e., optimized and suitable for all browsers and mobile devices) and customizable to your corporate identity. We have designed this seamless integration of payment forms/pages for you to avoid a separate integration for each payment method. It offers you integration for all payment methods and maximum flexibility. This integration also automatically covers future, new payment methods without any further integration updates from your side being necessary. You can preconfigure (i.e., activate or deactivate) the payment methods displayed on the Payment Page in our [Novalnet Admin Portal](https://admin.novalnet.de/). By adding two additional parameters with corresponding values in the payment request, you can dynamically set the hosted payment page to display only one payment method instead of all the enabled payment methods
